generated_content.authored_remainder: Include the authored remainder; record generated line and region counts per file
generated_content.generated_only: Exclude file if, after generated-region removal, comment/metadata/navigation-marker removal and markup stripping, no eligible alphanumeric text remains
generated_content.region_action: Blank every source line from marker start through marker end, preserving physical line numbering
generated_content.whole_file: Explicit generated-file header in first 12 physical lines, except a bounded generated-region marker is not a whole-file declaration
